1.mascotDialogue: One edge, two entries in the adjacency matrix! Forget the second, and congratulations, you built half a directed graph by accident.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 2 and line 3 aren't optional extras of each other — they're the same conceptual edge, and gotta go in as one atomic pair, every single time.

3.mascotDialogue: No arrowheads this time — just a plain line, 'cause the connection's mutual by nature.

4.mascotDialogue: The visual shows a single arrowhead where an undirected graph should never have one at all — that mismatch's the bug, güey, and pretty hard to miss.
